claims.text: POL-NS-01 makes the no-show fee chargeable only if all four of its limbs hold, and limb (d) fails squarely on the face of the trip record: the ride was terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is not one of the three codes limb (d) recognises (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT). The clause states expressly that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The anchor condition for this charge is therefore not met, whatever else the record shows.

On the driver's own GPS evidence this is exactly the outcome POL-NS-01 resolves for the rider: the driver's stationary fixes sit inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous qualifying run of 200 seconds, from 19:11:48 to 19:15:08, across 21 qualifying fixes, so the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE branch applies. The fee is not chargeable, and the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee carried as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 on the fare breakdown is refunded to the rider in full with no driver compensation, the mis-selected reason code being recorded as a driver-education referral.

Independently of limb (d), POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider on every limb of its test. Limb (a): the chat log shows the rider sending a locating message inside the waiting window - 'at the lift lobby' at 19:12:48 - in answer to the driver's 'cannot find you, where are you'. Limb (b): the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message and the trip record shows no in-app call at any point before he cancelled at 19:15:10. Limb (c): the rider's own track stayed inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius throughout, with a maximum distance of 19.67 m and 40 of 40 fixes qualifying. The cancellation fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation payable.

The bundle is clean on every fact that decides this dispute, so it should be decided and not deflected to review: the trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare breakdown are each COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, the trace runs at 100.0% coverage with no gaps, and the chat sequence numbering and message count are intact, so no clock-skew, trace, chat or fare defect under POL-NS-08 is present. Because none of the deciding facts rests on impaired evidence, the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap does not bite and POL-NS-09(a) is not engaged.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup: EV-ADVIS-02748-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0, an absence that is itself citable. Under POL-NS-06 the only route by which a driver's separate in-geofence intervals could be summed toward the waiting period requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, so there is nothing on this record that could be used to extend or excuse the waiting clock on the driver's side.

POL-NS-01(a) and limb (b), read with the POL-NS-02 proximity test, are therefore both made out, and the trace supporting them is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100% coverage and no gaps.

The driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 200 seconds - 21 consecutive qualifying fixes from 19:11:48 to 19:15:08 - which exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip under platform_policy.free_wait_sec; the derived shortfall_sec is -20.0, that is, no shortfall. POL-NS-01(c) is satisfied, and because the dwell is not shorter than the free waiting period the premature-cancellation refund route in POL-NS-06 is not engaged. The record sets no longer no_show_threshold_sec, so no additional threshold applies to the cancellation in limb (d).

This is not a false-arrival case under POL-NS-05. At the marker timestamp the trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 19:11:48, inside the 50 m radius, so the 'I'm Here' tap was not pressed from more than 300 m away, and the driver's nearest approach to the pin across the trace is 0.44 m; the driver was stationary at the pickup, not travelling at 15 km/h or more. The arrival marker therefore validly started the waiting clock, and no false-arrival event should be recorded against the driver.

The termination was not an abandonment of the pickup. The chat log shows the driver opened contact 30 seconds after arriving ('cannot find you, where are you', 19:12:18), the rider answered 'at the lift lobby' at 19:12:48, and the driver then held position for a further 142 seconds, terminating only at 19:15:10 after the full free waiting period had been served. The rider's own track records 40 fixes all at 0.0 km/h across the window, so nothing in the admissible trace shows the rider moving towards the vehicle before termination.

The cancelled trip's money is internally sound: EV-FARE-02748 carries a cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, equal to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50) and to fee_schedule.defaults (4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and no fare-integrity ground on which to discount this dispute. The contested amount is SGD 4.50 and the fare breakdown shows it charged with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00.

No POL-NS-09 limb is engaged and there is no basis to hold the fee or send this trip to human review. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute count of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (137) is 0.007, below the 0.08 rate - both limbs are required and neither holds. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so the repeat-dispute trigger is absent. The trip record and the GPS trace agree on arrival, dwell and rider presence rather than contradicting each other, and the only impaired artifact in the bundle is EV-ADVIS-02748-01, MISSING under issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at weight 0.0, which carries no deciding fact and on which no driver claim relies.

The driver does not press the fee and does not claim compensation. ruling.explanation:
To both parties — the SGD 4.50 no-show fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable.

The cancellation was made by the driver at 19:15:10 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE (EV-TRIP-02748). POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four of its limbs hold, and limb (d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The clause states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE — the driver's own statement that he could not find the rider — does not satisfy limb (d). Limb (d) therefore fails, and the SGD 4.50 fee line on EV-FARE-02748 (payment status CHARGED, refund issued SGD 0.00) is not chargeable. The same clause then fixes the consequence by geography: where the driver's stationary fixes lie INSIDE the arrival radius this is a full refund of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and that is what the driver's own trace shows. POL-NS-03 does not apply, because that clause governs fixes outside the radius but within 400 m, and POL-NS-02's 'never arrived' branch would require fixes more than 400 m away.

For the driver. What your record does establish is accepted, and it does not save the charge. You arrived at 19:11:48 (EV-TRIP-02748), inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same second with a dwell start offset of 0.0 s. You held position for a continuous 200 seconds over 21 qualifying fixes, 19:11:48 to 19:15:08, against the 180-second free waiting period in force (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so there is no POL-NS-06 shortfall (derived shortfall -20.0 s). The 'I'm Here' marker was not false under POL-NS-05: the trace placed you inside the radius at that second and you were stationary (nearest approach 0.44 m), not travelling at 15 km/h or more, so no false-arrival referral arises. The money is sound: the SGD 4.50 line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50) and the schedule default, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The trade-off the policy makes is that a correctly waited pickup recorded under the wrong reason code is still not chargeable; your own claim on this point does not press the fee and claims no POL-NS-07 payout, and it is right.

For the rider. Independently of limb (d), POL-NS-04 exonerates you on all three limbs: you sent a locating message inside the waiting window ('at the lift lobby', 19:12:48, EV-CHAT-02748); the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of it and made no in-app call before cancelling at 19:15:10; and your device stayed inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius on 40 of 40 fixes, maximum 19.67 m (EV-GPS-02748). Full refund, no driver compensation.

Confidence is not reduced by POL-GEN-02(2). The deciding facts rest on artifacts all at weight 1.0: the reason code and timestamps on EV-TRIP-02748, the in-radius dwell and rider presence on EV-GPS-02748, the chat on EV-CHAT-02748 and the fee line on EV-FARE-02748. No POL-NS-08 limb is met (100% coverage, no gaps, chat sequence intact, fare reconciles), so the cap is 1.0. EV-ADVIS-02748-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, but it carries no deciding fact here — the dwell was a single in-geofence interval, so the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation rule that needs a traffic advisory is not in issue — and it is named in the discarded-claim audit below. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged (no profile counter in play reaches its test, and no two artifacts contradict each other), so the case is not escalated.

The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, which does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so the refund executes automatically on issue.

The code was mis-selected and should be corrected for this driver.

Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (closest approach 0.44 m, EV-GPS-02748), POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome at FULL_REFUND of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and directs that the mis-selected reason code be recorded as a driver-education referral, which is the referral above. Second, POL-NS-04 independently exonerates you: you sent a locating message inside the waiting window ('at the lift lobby', 19:12:48, EV-CHAT-02748); the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of it and made no in-app call before cancelling; and your device stayed within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for all 40 of 40 qualifying fixes (maximum 19.67 m). To the driver: your arrival and waiting are accepted as recorded. Your 'I'm Here' tap at 19:11:48 is matched by the first qualifying in-geofence fix at the same second (dwell-start offset 0.0 s, EV-GPS-02748), and you held position for a continuous 200 seconds across 21 qualifying fixes from 19:11:48 to 19:15:08, which exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in force (platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The marker was not a false arrival under POL-NS-05 - you were inside the 50 m radius at the tap, not more than 300 m away and not travelling at 15 km/h or more - and because the dwell is not short of the minimum, POL-NS-06 does not apply. No POL-NS-07 payout is made, however, because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full: limb (d) fails on its own terms, and you do not press the fee or claim compensation; the 80 percent figure of SGD 3.60 is therefore not payable. No POL-NS-09 limb is engaged: the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below 4, and 1/137 = 0.007, below 0.08), neither party shows repeat counterparty disputes, the record's artifacts agree rather than contradict, and no artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d) carries a deciding fact - so the case is not escalated and no false-arrival entry is made. The only impaired artifact is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02748-01, MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no deciding fact, and the claim resting on it was discarded at the citation check for not disclosing that impairment. The deciding facts rest on EV-TRIP-02748 and EV-GPS-02748, both at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 cap is 1.0 and no escalation floor is breached. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, does not exceed the execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the refund executes automatically.
